Name: ControlPanel
Author: K1ngmak1r
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b]Control Panel[/b] is an all-in-one cheat and utility mod for Stardew Valley, designed to give players greater freedom and control over their gameplay.
Spawn items, manage your money, remove unwanted objects, relocate farm buildings, adjust movement speed, walk through obstacles, teleport across the world, and control in-game time — all from a convenient in-game interface.
The mod features a clean, easy-to-use control panel that can be opened with [b]F6[/b] (customizable).
Whether you want to experiment with farm layouts, build without restrictions, save time, or simply have fun, Control Panel brings powerful tools together in one place.
[b]Language Support:[/b]
[list]
[*]English (Default)[/*]
[*]Turkish[/*]
[*]Simplified Chinese[/*]
[/list]The interface automatically follows your game's language when supported. Unsupported languages fall back to English.
Built for SMAPI without requiring additional content or configuration mods.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Installation via Vortex (Recommended)[/b][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install Stardew Valley and the latest compatible version of SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download Control Panel using the "Mod Manager Download" button.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Open Vortex and install the downloaded mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Enable the mod and deploy your mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Load your save and press [b]F6[/b] to open Control Panel.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Manual Installation[/b][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download the mod using the "Manual Download" button.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the downloaded ZIP file.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the[/color]

[code]ControlPanel[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder inside your Stardew Valley[/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Load a save file and press [b]F6[/b].[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Note:[/b] The menu key can be changed directly from the Control Panel interface. No additional installation scripts are required.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Item Spawner[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Search for items by name or item ID.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Add items directly to your inventory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Adjust the quantity of spawned items.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Supports items registered in the game's item database, including compatible modded items.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Money Management[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]View your current gold balance.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Instantly add or remove money.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Manage your funds directly from the interface.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Remover Tool[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Remove unwanted farm objects and obstacles.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Clear certain bushes, rocks, and terrain features.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Enable or disable the tool from Control Panel.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Relocater & Force Placement[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Move placed objects and supported farm buildings.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Relocate structures to normally restricted areas.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Preview placement positions before confirming.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Fine-tune placement for more accurate positioning.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Movement Speed[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Increase or decrease your character's movement speed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Enter custom speed values.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Does not accelerate the entire game or NPCs.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]No Collision[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Walk through walls, fences, trees, and other obstacles.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Cross water without normal collision restrictions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Toggle the feature on or off instantly.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Teleportation[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Access a dedicated world map page.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Teleport to predefined locations.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Travel quickly without walking across the map.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Time Control[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Move the in-game clock forward or backward.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Adjust time in 10-minute or 60-minute increments.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Available from the Map / Time page.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Additional Features[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Customizable menu hotkey (default: F6).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Automatic language selection.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]English, Turkish, and Simplified Chinese support.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Clean, dark-themed interface.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI-based functionality.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Important:[/b] Some advanced features, particularly Force Placement, No Collision, and time manipulation, may affect normal gameplay behavior. Backing up your save before experimenting is recommended.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Required:[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or newer[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.3.0 or newer[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Additional Dependencies:[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]None.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Control Panel works through SMAPI and does not require Content Patcher or Generic Mod Config Menu.
[b]Compatibility Notes:[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Designed for the PC version of Stardew Valley.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Supports English, Turkish, and Simplified Chinese.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Other game languages use the English interface.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Compatibility with all third-party mods is not guaranteed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Back up your save files before using advanced farm editing features.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Special thanks to [b]ConcernedApe[/b] for creating Stardew Valley and its wonderful world.
Thanks to [b]Pathoschild and the SMAPI contributors[/b] for developing and maintaining the modding framework that makes projects like this possible.
And thank you to the Stardew Valley modding community for its creativity, resources, and continued support.
Enjoy Control Panel, and happy farming![/color]
